verdict.rationale: Replicate's own docs show image-generation and image-editing models that run on the same API platform as thousands of other community and proprietary models, all callable with one line of code. However, the pack has no evidence of vision (image-understanding) or audio models, nor of text-chat models alongside them, so the multimodal breadth the story asks for is only partly shown. missing for 10: documented vision/image-understanding models, documented audio (speech/music/transcription) models, explicit evidence of text-chat models on the same platform, independent or hands-on corroboration of multimodal calls.

support.subject: As a developer, I can call vision, audio, or image-generation models beyond text chat on the same platform

citations.quote: Our community has already published thousands of models that are ready to use in production. You can run these with one line of code.
